release_rule: Release wave 1 only. Wait until every released job is terminal, validate identity, stereochemistry, composition and unique-basin coverage, then release held waves only if needed.
stop_rule: Target-success count is necessary but not sufficient: stop only after low-energy basin rediscovery, no new important basin in the latest completed wave, motif coverage and downstream ensemble-stability gates pass. Never cancel RUNNING or COMPLETING work.
goat_method: GOAT-ENTROPY XTB ALPB; 8 ranks; maxcore 2000 MB per rank
